capabilities: create MADR decision records from versioned templates
configure target folders and default metadata values
validate records with a live sidebar checklist
lint Markdown formatting using the markdownlint rule set
extras: README warns the plugin was developed with agentic AI coding tools and advises reviewing the source before trusting it in sensitive vaults; the listing is not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in support for authoring MADR-format decision records or flagging missing sections and leftover template placeholders.

relations.evidence: formatting issues found by markdownlint, using MADR's own rule set

summary: MADR authoring plugin that creates architecture decision record notes from templates and checks them with a live completeness checklist.
